versions.changelog:
No visible file or documentation changes detected in this release.  
• Version bumped to 1.1.0, but no user-facing changes are documented.

- Initial release of the open-meteo-api skill.
- Fetch current weather, forecasts, historical data, and air quality for any coordinates with the free Open-Meteo API—no API key required.
- Includes a zero-dependency Python script for quick location-based weather queries, with options for forecast days, units, and output format.
- Direct API usage guides provided for geocoding, weather, air quality, marine, elevation, and more.
- Detailed parameter tables, usage examples, and WMO weather code reference included for easy integration and interpretation.
